parameters.command:
sqlite3 -json "/data/arabic_dict.db" "
SELECT e.id AS entry_id, e.dictionary_id, e.headword, e.headword_bare, e.headword_norm, e.root, e.root_source, e.pos, e.form, e.definitions_text, e.translation_en, e.translation_fr, e.domain, d.key AS dict_key, d.name_ar AS dict_name_ar, d.name_en AS dict_name_en, d.source_type AS dict_source_type, d.period AS dict_period, d.author AS dict_author, d.death_year AS dict_death_year
FROM entries e
JOIN dictionaries d ON e.dictionary_id = d.id
WHERE e.headword_norm IN ('خفياني', 'الخفياني', 'منجم', 'المنجم')
ORDER BY e.headword_norm, d.source_type, d.death_year ASC NULLS LAST;
"

sqlite3 -json "/data/arabic_dict.db" "
SELECT e.id AS entry_id, e.dictionary_id, e.headword, e.headword_bare, e.headword_norm, e.root, e.root_source, e.pos, e.form, e.definitions_text, e.translation_en, e.translation_fr, e.domain, d.key AS dict_key, d.name_ar AS dict_name_ar, d.name_en AS dict_name_en, d.source_type AS dict_source_type, d.period AS dict_period, d.author AS dict_author, d.death_year AS dict_death_year
FROM entries e
JOIN dictionaries d ON e.dictionary_id = d.id
WHERE e.id IN (
    SELECT rowid FROM entries_translations_fts
    WHERE entries_translations_fts MATCH 'translation_en:\"occultist\"'
    ORDER BY bm25(entries_translations_fts, 5.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    LIMIT 50
)
ORDER BY d.source_type, d.name_en;
"

sqlite3 -json "/data/arabic_dict.db" "
SELECT e.id AS entry_id, e.dictionary_id, e.headword, e.headword_bare, e.headword_norm, e.root, e.root_source, e.pos, e.form, e.definitions_text, e.translation_en, e.translation_fr, e.domain, d.key AS dict_key, d.name_ar AS dict_name_ar, d.name_en AS dict_name_en, d.source_type AS dict_source_type, d.period AS dict_period, d.author AS dict_author, d.death_year AS dict_death_year
FROM entries e
JOIN dictionaries d ON e.dictionary_id = d.id
WHERE e.id IN (
    SELECT rowid FROM entries_fts
    WHERE entries_fts MATCH '\"مؤمن\" OR \"خفية\" OR \"متبحر\" OR \"سحرية\"'
    ORDER BY bm25(entries_fts, 10.0, 5.0, 5.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    LIMIT 20
)
ORDER BY d.source_type, d.name_en;
"

sqlite3 -json "/data/arabic_dict.db" "
SELECT e.id AS entry_id, e.dictionary_id, e.headword, e.headword_bare, e.headword_norm, e.root, e.root_source, e.pos, e.form, e.definitions_text, e.translation_en, e.translation_fr, e.domain, d.key AS dict_key, d.name_ar AS dict_name_ar, d.name_en AS dict_name_en, d.source_type AS dict_source_type, d.period AS dict_period, d.author AS dict_author, d.death_year AS dict_death_year
FROM entries e
JOIN dictionaries d ON e.dictionary_id = d.id
WHERE e.id IN (
    SELECT rowid FROM entries_translations_fts
    WHERE entries_translations_fts MATCH 'translation_en:\"occult\" OR translation_en:\"occultism\" OR translation_en:\"mystic\" OR translation_en:\"sorcerer\"'
    ORDER BY bm25(entries_translations_fts, 5.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    LIMIT 20
)
ORDER BY d.source_type, d.name_en;
"

هذه المجموعة حيث أن المُنَجم مختص بقراءة النجوم واستطلاع الغيب، بينما المفهوم هنا أوسع ويشمل المتبحرين في شتى الفنون السحرية والعلوم الخفية.
